hooks.command: read -r INPUT; CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | sed 's/.*"command": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\bgit\s+push\b' && [ -n "$OVERSTORY_AGENT_NAME" ] && [ "$OVERSTORY_AGENT_NAME" != "orchestrator" ]; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Overstory worker agents must not push; merge to the canonical repo and push from the orchestrator/main session."}'; exit 0; fi;
read -r INPUT; TOOL_NAME=$(echo "$INPUT" | sed 's/.*"tool_name": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/'); overstory log tool-start --agent orchestrator --tool-name "$TOOL_NAME"
read -r INPUT; TOOL_NAME=$(echo "$INPUT" | sed 's/.*"tool_name": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/'); overstory log tool-end --agent orchestrator --tool-name "$TOOL_NAME"
